Marie T.New York, NY 355 928 3276 Aug 13, 2017 5 photos First to Review I came here for my son's school health check up - $3,000 yen. I made the mistake and went to the RIVER CITY CLINIC across the street, but those are adult clinics. This children's clinic is next to the pharmacy and is accessible from the first floor, outside (There is no building lobby that you need to pass through). There is one lady there who speaks English well who will act as an interpreter between patient and doctor if needed. Upon arrival and checking in, my son and I were ushered into a small room which had a bed with various stuffed animals.
